clubSession.description: Use the token returned by account creation or recovery.

Failure.description: Request failed. The HTTP status distinguishes invalid input, authentication, authorization, conflict, throttling and service failures.

code.description: 10-character invite code. The server accepts separators and lower case.

nextCheckpoint.description: The first checkpoint in plan order that this member has yet to complete.

isSpoiler.description: Conceal for other members until they explicitly reveal it. Replies inherit concealment from a marked parent.

concealed.description: When true, the body is empty and the passage fields are null.

discussionTools.description: This instance supports pinned prompts and individual post reveal.

focusedPost.description: Present when focus is requested. Contains the visible requested post, including normal spoiler masking, or null if it is unavailable in this thread.
